boundaries: Automatically initialized rank-deficient free maps are rejected: source initial.spg lm returns nonfinite starting values. Fixed unused/dependent coordinates remain accepted.

EFS with a nonidentity effective paraPen map is guarded. Rectangular source maps fail; square source maps are accepted but efsudr ignores L/lsp0 and returns an unmapped fitted state inconsistent with exported mapped full.sp. Fixed mapped SPs without selection remain usable with the EFS spelling.

Positive min_sp with nonidentity maps is guarded: source minimum penalties enter full penalty H, while the existing underlying-SP floor route cannot represent that composition. A square-map source acceptance capture records this as a current implementation boundary.
General-family formula lists reject paraPen upstream, including multinom K=1; the flat source variant also fails. Mapped transformed-coefficient compositions remain explicitly unimplemented.
Default rescaled gam.vcomp retains the existing paraPen metadata guard; gam.vcomp(rescale=False) is covered separately in mgcv_parametric_map_vcomp.
